excerpt: You are born-again to be a high-flier – Prov. 4:18. Life is like a cafeteria. You take your tray, select your food and pay at the other end. You can get anything you want as long as you are willing to pay for the price.

title: The Saving Grace
excerpt: Grace simply means undeserved or unmerited favour. It simply means when God does for you what you don’t deserve.

title: The Giving Grace
excerpt: The Grace of God is the maker of men; no glorious destiny can be constructed without the ingredient of Grace.

title: The Healing Grace
excerpt: Sickness and weakness are all satanic afflictions. They are arrows sent by the enemy to slow you down in the journey of life. You can be made strong out of your weakness.

title: The Prosperity Grace
excerpt: Very shortly, you will become an object of argument. Your hand will no longer be empty. Your pocket will no longer be empty. Your hand will not touch the bottom of your pocket or bag again.

title: The Leading Grace
excerpt: There is a Grace that will cause you to take the lead in all you do. It causes you to emerge as the head even among heads and to shine brighter even among stars (Deut. 28:13). In life, you go ahead by Grace and you also become the head by Grace.

title: How to Access Grace
excerpt: 2Co 9:14, ‘And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.’

title: Labour to Be Blessed
excerpt: The greatest threat to Christianity is Christians trying to make it to Heaven without doing anything for God. In life, we are owners of nothing but stewards of everything. Stewardship a call to labour.

title: In Pursuit of Wisdom
excerpt: Many are working very hard and yet things are very hard for them, because they are not working with wisdom. Work is defined as applying force in the right direction. One of the major benefits of wisdom is also direction. Eccl. 10:10 says, ‘...

title: Be Strong in the Lord!
excerpt: Those who dominate in the spiritual realm will automatically dominate in the physical realm. This is because everything is a spiritual situation before it becomes a physical condition. In this New Year, you must be fervent in spirit.

title: Speak Up for Jesus!
excerpt: As a child of God, you are the mouthpiece of God on earth. The only thing that will cause evil to grow its peak is for Christians to remain silence.

title: Your Time, Your Life
excerpt: You must master the art of investing your time because time lost can never be recovered. One of the dictionary definitions of investment is ‘to spend time or effort with the expectation of some satisfaction’.

title: Breaking the Chains of Pornography Addiction
excerpt: Your eye is the door to your life. Whatever your eyes behold is what your heart will naturally pursue and determine the direction your body will follow. The birth of Samson was a mysterious one.

title: Stop the Excuses!
excerpt: Losers always have a book full of excuses to tell you why they could not.

title: The Most Important Prayer
excerpt: Friend, the most dangerous place to be is to be outside the will of God for your life. It is only God who knows the ending from the beginning. Our parents got to know us after we were born, but God knew us even before we were born.

title: What You Have Can Create What You Need!
excerpt: In life, you must understand that although you don’t have everything, you definitely have something . In fact, there is something within you that the world cannot do without.

title: The Mystery of Seeds and Harvest
excerpt: One major thing you must remember is that what you are doing today whether good or bad is a seed; whatever is done to you tomorrow is your harvest. Your life today is just a reflection of your decisions, choices and actions yesterday.

title: You Are on the Mind of God
excerpt: What did they call Zacchaeus in his hometown of Jericho? Most folks recognized him as the chief tax collector. The Romans may have identified him with a number. He was merely one instrument in the huge machine that brought revenues pouring into Rome.

title: How to Make a Big Difference
excerpt: What difference are we making? Big or small, it does not matter. If everyone made a small difference, we would end up with a big difference, wouldn’t we?

title: The Proof of Greatness
excerpt: When God called Abraham, he was a nobody but by the time God was through with him, greatness had become the signature of his life.

title: The Long Road
excerpt: Ayoung girl gave her teacher a very special gift. It was a beautiful seashell. “Where did you get this?” she asked. The child told her that such shells are found only on a certain faraway beach.

title: Turning Misery into Ministry
excerpt: God often uses sorrow in our lives to open our eyes to the pain of others and to equip us to comfort them. Something good happens when we get our eyes off our own pain and minister out of it to hurting people.

title: The Greatest Mistake You Can Ever Make
excerpt: The greatest mistake you can make in your life is to STOP DOING the very things that took you to the level you are today. T he SACRIFICES that changed your story must always be maintained if you don’t want to DIMINISH IN GLORY!

title: How to Move to the Next Level
excerpt: Everyone avoided going to take care of the flock of Jesse, except David. On that duty post, the anointing located him. King Saul, his soldiers and every Israelite avoided Goliath.

title: Learn to Celebrate Others
excerpt: King Saul instead of providing quality leadership for Israel vacated his throne and went into a chasing spree after an ordinary citizen of the land and a teenage shepherd called David.

title: The Footprints of God
excerpt: Several years ago, a great French scientist was crossing the Arabian desert under the influence of an Arab (Christian) tourist guide. Along the way, the sat down to take a rest and the guide started praying.

title: How to Be Fruitful in the Land of Suffering
excerpt: I52 Joseph named his second son Ephraim, for he said, “God has made me fruitful in this land of my grief.”

title: Learn to Do What Is Right Even When It Is Difficult
excerpt: One of the greatest qualities you MUST possess as a person is the WILL TO DO WHAT IS RIGHT EVEN WHEN IT IS HARD AND DIFFICULT. Count on it, the day will come when ‘progress and success’ call for compromising your convictions and principles.

title: The Value-System of Heaven
excerpt: The measuring Scale of God is different from that of men because the values of God are completely different from those of men. The value-system of Heaven is different from that of men.

title: The Starting Point of Transformation
excerpt: Every Samson who’s laid with a Delilah, every David who committed adultery with a Bathsheba and later betrayed his Uriah, every Judas who sold out his Jesus began his downfall with a THOUGHT.
tags: When you are starting something new

title: How to Achieve All Your Dreams
excerpt: The Bible says in Daniel 11:32 that “... the people that do know their God shall be strong and do exploits”. It means that by our association with divinity, our abilities must take us to a realm of unending exploits.

title: Persevere No Matter What!
excerpt: Most people fail in life not because they lack knowledge or talent but because they quit . When problems seem insurmountable, quitting may look like the easiest way out. It is true for every marriage, ministry, job and relationship.

title: How to Put a Smile on the Face of God
excerpt: May the love of God that drove Christ to the cross now drive us to the lost. If soul-winning is not your priority then you are out of touch with Heaven.

title: The Biggest Problem of Every Person
excerpt: When the 10 spies were saying it was not possible for the children of Israel to possess the promised land, Caleb said, ‘let us go up at once and possess the land, for we are well able to overcome it (Numbers 13:30)

title: The Creative Power of the Word
excerpt: God’s Word has creative power and calls into existence the very thing of which it speaks. If you are sick, the Word can create your healing; if you are poor, the Word can bring into existence your victory.

title: The Accomplishing Power of the Word
excerpt: Iwant you to develop a new approach to God’s Word. If you don’t change your negative approach to God’s Word, you will surely end as a reproach. The Bible says that God is not a man that He should lie (Numb. 3:19).

title: God Can Handle It
excerpt: In the realm of God, there is nothing which is impossible. What is beyond men is below God. Men can fail, but God will always prevail.

title: You Shall Experience a Change of Story
excerpt: One of these days, you will wake up in the robes of a king in Jesus Name! What you must remember is that in every pain, there is a hidden gain. The challenges of life must never cause you to give up.

title: Stop Waiting, Wondering and Wishing
excerpt: Most people have never learnt to take responsibility for their lives. When such people fail, they blame it on everyone apart from themselves. However, those who normally excel in the journey of life always take responsibility for their lives.
tags: When you are waiting on God

title: Overcoming Evil Decrees
excerpt: As a Christian, you must never be ignorant of evil or demonic decrees. One of the major weapons the enemy uses to keep people in bondage is evil decrees.

title: The Road to Greatness
excerpt: Performance in any duty or assignment is enhanced when you consider the task as a privilege. When you take any assignment for granted, you start failing at it. Every man is at his peak performance whenever it is seen as a privilege to serve.

title: The Mystery of Sacrifice
excerpt: One of the greatest mysteries you must understand is the mystery of altars. An altar is a place where spirits meet; IT IS A PLACE OF SACRIFICE.

title: Check Who You Are Following
excerpt: It is very surprising that most people pay attention to the quality of water they drink, the quality of food they eat, the quality of dress they wear, the quality of house they build and the quality of air they breathe BUT THEY RARELY PAY ATTENTION TO THE QUALITY & CALIBRE OF PEOPLE THEY FOLLOW!
